bio.text: Carl Boyanton is an independent candidate for Mississippi's 4th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
Boyanton was born in Memphis, was raised across Mississippi and attended Pearl River County public schools.
A Mississippi Gulf Coast resident, Boyanton owns a business, Farmer Fresh Produce.

sources.title: Meet the Candidates for Mississippi's 4th Congressional District in the Nov. 3 Elections
